title: Zstd Compression Option Rolled Back
summary: The recently added Zstd compression algorithm option for Pub/Sub messages has been removed. Developers using or planning to use Zstd compression should revert to other supported algorithms.
details: The `ZSTD` enum value has been removed from the `compressionAlgorithm` property within the `schemas.Compression` object. This effectively rolls back the Zstd compression support that was recently introduced. Any applications configured to use `ZSTD` for message compression will now encounter errors and should be updated to use `GZIP` or no compression.
